_comment: Walker2d-v4 | EXTERNAL SB3-Zoo PPO checkpoint (HuggingFace sb3/ppo-Walker2d-v3) | 2026-07-08
_env_version_note: v4, not v5: gymnasium 0.29.1 (the Kaggle stack pin) provides MuJoCo envs up to v4 only. Policies trained on v3, deployed on v4 — declared gap.
_provenance: Policy trained by the RL-Baselines3-Zoo project on Walker2d-v3 (single seed, zoo hyperparameters: env_wrapper=sb3_contrib.common.wrappers.TimeFeatureWrapper, normalize=True — see https://huggingface.co/sb3/ppo-Walker2d-v3). Fetch + rename via training/fetch_walker2d_zoo.py. Declared scope: n=1 per algorithm, no M1/M2/M3 regime axis, trained-on-v3/deployed-on-v4 version gap. Cross-morphology DEMONSTRATION of black-box audit on an externally trained policy — not a replication of the Hopper protocol. Run baseline first; the pre-deployment gate (30% rule) decides admissibility.
_obs_wrapper_note: TimeFeatureWrapper adds a 1-dim time-remaining feature (17-dim Walker2d obs -> 18-dim), matching this checkpoint's saved VecNormalize rms shape -- required or model.predict()/normalization crashes with a shape mismatch. Side effect: the audit's raw_env_obs stream (and therefore D_k) also sees this synthetic channel, not just physical state. Part of the declared external-checkpoint gap, not a protocol deviation for the native Hopper/Walker2d subjects (which don't set this key). sb3/sac-Walker2d-v3 does not use this wrapper (normalize=False) -- see walker2d_zoo_sac.json.
_t0_note: 510k, off the window grid — lesson of the Hopper boundary artefact (thesis sec 3.1.2).

drift_params._comment: 1.5x nominal gravity — same perturbation as configs/walker2d.json

_hard_failure_counts_rationale: Reset-free deployment (v12.9 stop-on-first-failure): first fall = T_hard, matching the Hopper protocol.
